sources.title: A New Type of White Nephrite ... Mida Deposit
sources.observed_text: Ivory white, semi-translucent to opaque; porcelain-to-greasy lustre. Deposit-specific atypical mineral texture; comparison to other Xinjiang nephrites in introduction.
sources.application: Body colour and subtle optical depth reference; avoid universal numerical assumptions

sources.title: Jade High-stemmed Cup / 西漢玉高足杯
sources.observed_text: Lustrous semi-translucent white jade; blue-green discolouration at rim/handle/foot is attributed to bronze corrosion.
sources.application: Compare slender curved edge light response with thicker body; do not copy corrosion colour as base jade

sources.title: 鎏金铜框玉盖杯
sources.observed_text: Cast bronze window-lattice frame with inserted jade panels; gilded copper rim around a single jade lid piece.
sources.application: Material separation and physical support/termination reference; retain C4 rather than reproduce cup decoration
